methods.label: Count days beyond complete weeks
methods.explanation:
Weekdays repeat every \(7\) days, so complete weeks do not change the weekday.

The successive Leap Days here occur in \(2004,2008,2012,2016,2020\). Between each pair of successive Leap Days there are four years of \(365\) days plus one extra February day, giving
\[
4\cdot365+1=1461\text{ days}.
\]
There are four such intervals from \(2004\) to \(2020\), so the elapsed time is
\[
4\cdot1461=5844=7\cdot834+6\text{ days}.
\]
The weekday therefore advances \(6\) days. Six days after Sunday is \(\boxed{\text{Saturday}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
